# Ring & Respond

> Ring & Respond is Sunny, an AI receptionist for dental offices. Sunny answers the calls a dental office misses — after hours and during overflow — in the practice's name, captures appointment requests (caller name, validated callback number, reason, preferred time), and flags urgent callers as top priority on the team's callback list. She answers in English, Spanish, Arabic, and Farsi. Sunny does not book appointments directly; the office confirms every request. She does not diagnose or give medical advice.

## Plans

- After-Hours Capture: $199/month
- 24/7 Complete: $299/month
- Extra locations: 20% off per additional location
- $0 setup (done-for-you setup included)
- Paid 30-day pilot: first month up front, unconditional money-back guarantee, go-live in 5 days or less, capture report around day 25
- Month-to-month, no contract, no exit fee

## Common questions

- **How much does a dental answering service cost?** Traditional dental answering services typically cost $200–$600/month plus per-minute or per-call charges. AI receptionist services range from about $149 to $1,299/month. Ring & Respond charges $0 setup, then a flat $199/month for After-Hours Capture or $299/month for 24/7 Complete, with no per-minute fees. Full breakdown: https://www.ringandrespond.com/dental-answering-service-cost
- **What should a dental office look for in an AI receptionist?** Buyers typically weigh: whether it is built only for dental offices, whether pricing is published, whether the AI books directly into the practice software (Dentrix, Open Dental, Eaglesoft) or captures requests for the office to confirm, what languages it answers in, and whether a BAA is offered. Sunny is dental-only, publishes flat pricing, captures appointment requests (the office confirms in its own system — no direct PMS write-back), answers in English, Spanish, Arabic, and Farsi, and offers a live demo line anyone can call and test first: (619) 202-1085.
- **Is an AI receptionist HIPAA compliant?** It depends on the vendor's stack and whether they will sign a BAA. What Sunny handles, what she never collects, and the questions to ask any vendor: https://www.ringandrespond.com/hipaa-ai-receptionist-dental
